'''Imperial Communique #3674.11g''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] report authored by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Herrit]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] for the attention of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. It contained information regarding the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].
